title: Aao tareekh sunau mai shabe hijrat ki
body:
Aao tareekh sunau mai shabe hijrat ki
<<DIVIDER>>
ALI MAULA.. (8)
<<MINI>>
ALI ALI ALI ALI MAULA..(2)
Aao tareekh sunaun mai shab e hijrat ki..(3)
<<DIVIDER>>
Kis tarha saaye mein..(2)
Talwaro'n ke soye the ALI
<<MINI>>
Aao tareekh sunaun mai shab e hijrat ki..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
1) Tegh ki chaao'n me sona koi aasaan nahi
Kulle imaa'n hai ALI (aam musalmaan nahi)..(2)
Dusra hota to..(2), bedaar nahi hota kabhi
<<MINI>>
Aao tareekh sunaun mai shab e hijrat ki - 2
<<DIVIDER>>
2) Chand se ye ABUTALIB ka qamar kehta tha
Aajki raat ibadat ka hai andaaz naya
Aaj ALLAH se..(2), sote hue batein hongi
<<MINI>>
Aao tareekh sunaun mai shab e hijrat ki -2
<<DIVIDER>>
3) Bas yahi soch ke hamla nahi kar paate the
Saare kuffar (isharo'n me yahi kehte the)..(2)
Hai NABI soye hue..(2), jaaga hua hoga ALI
<<MINI>>
Aao tareekh sunaun mai shab e hijrat ki -2
<<DIVIDER>>
4) Yehi siddeeq hai aur yehi amee'n hai logo'n
Kitna HAIDER pe bharosa hai NABI ko dekho
FATEMA sa jaisi..(2), amaanat bhi ALI ko dedi
<<MINI>>
Aao tareekh sunaun mai shab e hijrat ki - 2
<<DIVIDER>>
5) Har jagah aake farishto'n ne kiya hai apna
So gaya bistar e AHMED pe AMEER E KAABA
Aaj kaabe ki tarha odh k kaali kamli
<<MINI>>
Aao tareekh sunaun mai shab e hijrat ki -2
<<DIVIDER>>
6) Banke soyenge ALI aaj NABI hairat kya
Waqeya yaad karo sheb e ABITALIB ka
Inke bistar pe to..(2), sone k ALI hai aadi
<<MINI>>
Aao tareekh sunaun mai shab e hijrat ki -2
<<DIVIDER>>
7) Aayatein karti hai aaj bhi ailan ALI
Shab e bedari teri (neend pe qurban ALI)..(2)
Tere sone se hui..(2), deen e KHUDA ki chandi
<<MINI>>
Aao tareekh sunaun mai shab e hijrat ki - 2
<<DIVIDER>>
8) Mir Sajjad wo jab subha Madine ko chala
Rasta rokta aakar jo mere MOLA ka
Saare Makke me na..(2), tha itna bahadur koi
<<MINI>>
Aao tareekh sunaun mai shab e hijrat ki - 2
<<DIVIDER>>
ALI MAULA..(4)
<<MINI>>
ALI ALI ALI ALI MAULA....
author: Mir Hassan Mir
